section_summary.extract_value: This introduction discusses the complex relationship between creativity and attention, differentiating between divergent thinking and real-life creative accomplishments. It reviews prior work linking divergent thinking to attentional flexibility and real-life creativity to 'leaky' attention. The present study aims to investigate the role of attention and cognitive control in creativity, specifically how divergent thinking and creative achievement relate to attentional flexibility and cognitive control. Experiment 1 was a preliminary study to evaluate feasibility, while Experiment 2 improved upon it with a larger sample and by measuring real-life creative achievement and intelligence scores.
